findings: Owned motor execution admits only positive current non-path incidence whose truthful physical origin resolves to the same deepest causal owner; absent, held-over one-tick-shifted, unrelated, and ambiguous ownership cannot substitute.

Each learner owns serialized, sorted consequence entries keyed by live link and generation, begins with an empty entry set, and receives a write only after an accepted return updates an actually participating physical path.

Once an owner resolves, candidate preference reads only that owner's recent entries; pre-existing global LinkState consequence history, learned drive magnitude, and inherited participation do not become owned preference tie-breaks.
A unique recent owner-local consequence recalls its physical alternative, while the same entry becomes preference-inert after the existing four-tick window and deterministic neutral rotation resumes.

Owner-bearing opportunity, consequence-write, and preference-read traces expose the transition without adding a public learner-memory operation or semantic action, anatomy, target, score, episode, or evaluator identity.
The law composes through exact adjacent ancestry at depth three, recording and reading the deepest owner with byte-exact checkpoint replay and natural quiescence.
All 27 active core tests, four frozen experiment probes, strict candidate checks, deterministic artifacts, and the 0.05-second independent warm regression suite pass.
residual_uncertainty: The supported result is bounded learner-local proprioceptive consequence control through depth three; it does not establish bidirectional limit control, recruitment, nested consequence continuity, sibling coalitions, body composition, Academy capability, benchmarks, or authority.

Two independently constructed siblings trained on opposite alternatives in one body remain the next direct isolation discriminator; current evidence establishes per-owner storage and deepest-owner access but does not run that full sibling fixture.

Reflection, reversed training order, blocked output, and large dormant-surface scaling remain inherited controls or preregistered next checks rather than separate independent verification runs for this mechanism.
Discovery and verification support candidate sufficiency only; no default protocol adoption or authority transition was performed.
